SELECT s_store_name,
       s_street_number,
       s_street_name,
       s_street_type,
       s_suite_number,
       s_city,
       s_county,
       s_state,
       s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS ">120 days"
FROM store_returns
JOIN store_sales ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
GROUP BY s_store_name,
         s_street_number,
         s_street_name,
         s_street_type,
         s_suite_number,
         s_city,
         s_county,
         s_state,
         s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name,
         s_street_number,
         s_street_name,
         s_street_type,
         s_suite_number,
         s_city,
         s_county,
         s_state,
         s_zip
LIMIT 100
